task.title: Qlib production-scale rolling + registry admission
task.summary_zh: 把 OSS-QLIB-002 的 rolling pipeline 升級到 production scale：使用 MGMT-QLIB-001 已建好的 TWSE OHLCV dataset（≥50 instruments × ≥2 years），跑完整 rolling-window 訓練，產 model_artifact 並提交 registry admission packet。獨立檔案路徑。
acceptance: production_rolling_run.py exposes run_production(instrument_universe start_date end_date window_days) returning ExperimentRun dict with rolling_sharpe and rolling_ic per window
uses real TWSE dataset from MGMT-QLIB-001 dataset_manifest not synthetic data
produces model_artifact registered as artifact_type=model_artifact with checksum and lineage refs
registry_admission_packet.py emits admission_packet.json conforming to PromotionReadinessPacket schema
test asserts at least one rolling window produces non-trivial sharpe > 0 on test fixture
CPU-only no GPU no live broker
